title: What Is AIVideosUGC? Company Facts for Sellers | AIVideosUGC
description: What AIVideosUGC makes from a product photo or a product page link: store images, short ads, actors, voice, captions, and an editor. Plans from $24.50 a month.
lead: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo or a product page link into store images and short video ads. Here is what it does, what it costs, and what you can add before you publish.
summary: It makes store images and short videos from a product photo or a product page link. It can add an actor, a script (the words they say), a voice, and captions.
facts: AI product video tool and AI product photo tool for online stores
Online shop sellers, brands with their own online store, and marketers on Shopify, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook

6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Shapes are 9:16 (tall, for a phone), 1:1 (square), 16:9 (wide), 4:3 (a bit wide), or 3:4 (a bit tall). Made from a product photo or a product page link. You describe the scene in that same step.
White-background photos, photos in a real-life setting, photos with a person showing the product, a new background, and images for social ads. All of these start from a product photo.
A library of AI actors, who are people the tool makes, not real customers. Or build a presenter, a person you save from photos you are allowed to use, and reuse that person on the next video.
A spoken line in an AI voice, which is a generated voice, not a real recording. Also captions you can edit, and a song from the music library.
The tool can write the spoken line from your product and a short note about the buyer
The actor can say the line in more than one language. Pick the language when you make the video.
Shorten the clip, swap the actor, change the line, and fix captions in the tool.
Send a finished file to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from the tool, or download it and post it yourself
Your own software can start a photo or video here. That connection is called an API. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access.
Make several versions from one product photo. That group is a batch. Each version shows how many credits it uses before it starts. A credit is one unit from your plan.
Monthly plans from $24.50 with 200 credits. Pro is $35 with 300 credits, and Premium is $63 with 600 credits. There is no free plan. You see the credit cost before every photo or video.

Set aside when a photo or video starts, used when the file is delivered, and returned on their own if it fails. A photo is 24 credits. A 6-second video is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 seconds is 60, and 30 seconds is 120.
You can use downloaded photos and videos in ads and on your store. They have no watermark, which means no logo is stamped on the file.
Uploads and results stay in the customer's account and are not public
not_offered: There is no free plan. Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits.
A request is turned down when it asks for a celebrity or another public figure. It is also turned down for a logo or brand name you do not own.
A file that is delivered is not refunded. If a photo or video fails, the credits return to your balance on their own.
describe: AIVideosUGC is an online tool that turns a product photo, or a public product page link, into store images and short videos. You choose the shape and the length. You can add an actor, a script, a spoken line, captions, and music, then edit them in the tool. You see how many credits it uses. Then download a file with no watermark (no logo on it), or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook.

faq.a: An online tool for stores. Upload a product photo, or paste a product page link, and download a store image or a short video you can edit and publish.

Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. Pro is $35 with 300 credits, and Premium is $63 with 600 credits. Each photo or video shows its credit cost before it starts. If it fails, those credits come back. There is no free plan.

faq.q: Does an AIVideosUGC video include a spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. A short ad can include a spoken line, captions you can edit, and music from the library. A spokesperson clip uses an actor who says the line you write. See [AI spokesperson video](page:spokesperson-videos).

faq.q: What video settings can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Shapes are 9:16 (tall phone), 1:1 (square), 16:9 (wide), 4:3 (a bit wide), or 3:4 (a bit tall). The same product photo can become a tall ad, a square clip, or a wide one.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. The exact number is on screen before it starts.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. You can use downloaded photos and videos in ads and on your store. They have no watermark (no logo stamped on them). You can post them on selling sites, social sites, and your own store. Follow each site's rules.
Yes. Choose an actor from the library, or build a presenter from photos you are allowed to use. A presenter is a person you save. You can use that person again on the next video.

faq.q: Can my own software start a photo or video?
faq.a: Yes. The API is a connection that lets your own software start a photo or video. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version at a time?
faq.a: Yes. A batch means several versions from one product photo. Each version shows how many credits it uses before it starts.
